_comment: 0025 Grey crowned crane in dry savanna grass, flat overcast (R5 II CR3, 8192x5464) — final saved 2026-11-17 as a TIFF next to the source (exact folder not verified). Raw SO (not readable, entered by hand): AI Denoise only; no WB/Calibration change. Filter = one Camera Raw Filter on layer id 2 with 4 corrections (Subject, Background = inverted subject, Eye = radial ∩ subject, Vignette = radial MaskInverted=true minus subject) and one user Remove (background grass stem, $Rtch). $BigT (2.56 MB: the user's Select Subject bitmap + the Remove patch) is omitted — it cannot be replayed from this file: re-run Select Subject and the Remove in the filter, then clone the Subject component into the other corrections (new MaskSyncID, digests from the live read). Mask coords normalized to the UNCROPPED 8192x5464 layer. Local Exposure: dialog = 4 x stored. Calibration notes in recipes/inbox/2026-11-17-claude-0025-*.md.

raw_so_manual.Temperature/Tint: unchanged (no global cast: whites b* -3.2 at L* 74, grass hue 74-83 deg)
